senses.gloss: पुङ्ख पुङ्ख, m. The lower part of an arrow, containing the feathers and the shaft, Śāk. d. 10.
पुङ्खित पुङ्खित, i. e. पुङ्ख + इत, [] adj. Endowed with the पुङ्ख (see the last), Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 774.

पुङ्गव पुङ्गव, i. e. पुंस्-गव,
 1. m. A bull Hariv. 3796.
 2. As latter part of comp. words, Excellent, e. g. गज-, m. A pre-eminent elephant, Bhartṛ. 2, 26. नर-, m. An excellent warrior, Chr. 21, 12.
